trackerPurpose: Canonical machine-readable resume state for coding agents. Read this file first, then read phases.json entry matching currentPhase.

statusRules.not_started: Do not implement this phase until all prior phases are validated.
statusRules.blocked: Stop and resolve blocker before coding further.
statusRules.done: Implementation finished; validation evidence still incomplete.
statusRules.validated: Implementation and validation complete; next phase may start.

resumeProtocol: If any phase status is blocked, read blocker and do not continue until resolved.
Open implementation/phases.json and find currentPhase. Do not read any deleted per-phase HTML files.
Update this file: set evidence, set completedAt if done, set status validated only after validation passes, then advance currentPhase.
